page.overview:
Who is Genmai?

Genmai has somewhat long black hair and black eyes, his bangs hang inbetween and down the sides of his eyes.

Genmai, who was out in the hills, got lost, but he was actually kidnapped by Kajika and his group to lure Team 7 (especially Sasuke Uchiha) to them. Kakashi Hatake found him being attacked by a wolf and saved him. Trying to help Genmai, Kakashi suddenly got trapped along with Genmai in a sealing technique. After the defeat of Kajika and his group by Naruto Uzumaki and Sasuke, Kakashi and Genmai escaped from the technique and Team 7 returned him to his son.
